screens.title: What The Flint Focus is, and why it matters
paras: The Flint Focus is where our announcements, updates, and dates live now. A new one goes up each week by Tuesday at 5:00 PM at the latest, and sometimes sooner. The PIN is in the email that comes with it.

Here's why. I don't want our team meetings to be me telling you to do this by that date. I'd rather we spend that time on things we do together: learning from each other, working at our tables, and having some fun.

Why it matters: when everyone shows up already knowing what's coming, our meetings can be shorter, more hands-on, and more about you. Read and complete it by 8:00 PM Wednesday. At the end you'll get a code to email me.

options: So meetings can be about working together, not listening to James
So you don't have to come to meetings

screens.title: Our meetings, our pace
paras: How long a meeting takes is up to all of us. Each agenda has a pace built in. When we stay with it, we get through everything and get out sooner.

Several of you have told me the side conversations and running comments make meetings feel longer than they need to be. I hear that. This format is part of the fix. The rest is on all of us: respect each other's time and stay with the room.

check.q: What decides how long our meetings take?
options: The clock: it's always an hour
How well we all stay with the agenda

paras: Thursday, October 22, 3:15 to 6:15 PM in the main lobby. Residents make a book cover for their own story as they reflect on their identity and experiences. It's the same thing you'll make at Wednesday's meeting.

check.q: When and where is Home Sweet Flint?

after: If you pass by and you're not on shift, please stop and make a cover instead of walking past. It sets a good example and shows residents you care. Whether you realize it or not, people are watching.

screens.title: November 'Cuse Connect planning form: due Wednesday
paras: If you haven't submitted your planning form for your November 'Cuse Connect, it's due by the end of Wednesday's team meeting. If it isn't in by then, you'll fill it out at your table during the meeting.
Submit something, even if it isn't final. You can edit it anytime after. Waiting on a collab partner or still figuring out details? That's fine. Get it in the system now and revise it later.
If you're collaborating with someone who already submitted one, you're covered.

paras: Every 'Cuse Chat for every resident on your floor is due, 100% complete, by Friday, October 30 at 5:00 PM. No exceptions.
Some residents you just can't reach. If you've tried three different ways and still can't connect, use the 'Cuse Connect Attempted Connection form. It opens Monday, October 26.
